flush.name: flush
flush.description:
Drop the body's horizontal inset so content runs edge to edge.

For surfaces that own their own chrome to the card's edge — a command
palette, a `<List>` whose rows carry full-width hover states, a settings
pane with full-bleed section rules. Content dialogs (copy, form fields,
buttons) want the default inset, which lines their left edge up with the
title.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description:
Accessible name for the dialog when it renders no `<Kobalte.Title>` (i.e.
a header-less dialog). Kobalte's `Dialog.Content` only sets
`aria-labelledby` from a mounted `<Kobalte.Title>`, so a title-less dialog
would otherwise expose no accessible name (axe `aria-dialog-name`). When a
`title` IS provided that title already names the dialog, so this is ignored
to avoid two competing name sources.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

getAnchorRect.name: getAnchorRect
getAnchorRect.description:
Function that returns the anchor element's DOMRect. If this is explicitly
passed, it will override the anchor `getBoundingClientRect` method.

gutter.name: gutter
gutter.description:
The distance between the popper and the anchor element.
By default, it's 0 plus half of the arrow offset, if it exists.

flip.name: flip
flip.description:
Controls the behavior of the popper when it overflows the viewport:
  - If a `boolean`, specifies whether the popper should flip to the
    opposite side when it overflows.
  - If a `string`, indicates the preferred fallback placements when it
    overflows. The placements must be spaced-delimited, e.g. "top left".

slide.name: slide
slide.description: Whether the popper should slide when it overflows.

overlap.name: overlap
overlap.description: Whether the popper can overlap the anchor element when it overflows.

sameWidth.name: sameWidth
sameWidth.description:
Whether the popper should have the same width as the anchor element.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-anchor-width`.

fitViewport.name: fitViewport
fitViewport.description:
Whether the popper should fit the viewport. If this is set to true, the
popper positioner will have `maxWidth` and `maxHeight` set to the viewport size.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-content-available-width` and `--kb-popper-content-available-height`.

hideWhenDetached.name: hideWhenDetached
hideWhenDetached.description: Whether to hide the popper when the anchor element becomes occluded.

detachedPadding.name: detachedPadding
detachedPadding.description: The minimum padding in order to consider the anchor element occluded.

arrowPadding.name: arrowPadding
arrowPadding.description: The minimum padding between the arrow and the popper corner.

overflowPadding.name: overflowPadding
overflowPadding.description:
The minimum padding between the popper and the viewport edge.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-content-overflow-padding`.

options.name: options
options.description: An array of options to display as the available options.

agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

const Playground = () => { const [state, setState] = createStore({ index: 0, cycling: false, growOnly: true, duration: 600, bounce: 1.0, bounceSoft: 1.0, hybridTravel: 25, hybridEdge: 17, edge: 17, revealTravel: 0, }) const index = () => state.index const cycling = () => state.cycling const growOnly = () => state.growOnly const duration = () => state.duration const bounce = () => state.bounce const bounceSoft = () => state.bounceSoft const hybridTravel = () => state.hybridTravel const hybridEdge = () => state.hybridEdge const edge = () => state.edge const revealTravel = () => state.revealTravel let timer: number | undefined const text = () => TEXTS[index()] const next = () => setState("index", (value) => (value + 1) % TEXTS.length) const prev = () => setState("index", (value) => (value - 1 + TEXTS.length) % TEXTS.length) const toggleCycle = () => { if (cycling()) { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer) timer = undefined setState("cycling", false) return } setState("cycling", true) const tick = () => { next() timer = window.setTimeout(tick, 700 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 600)) } timer = window.setTimeout(tick, 700 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 600)) } onCleanup(() => { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer) }) const spring = () => `cubic-bezier(0.34, ${bounce()}, 0.64, 1)` const springSoft = () => `cubic-bezier(0.34, ${bounceSoft()}, 0.64, 1)` return (

stories.snippet:
const LongContent = () => (
What's inside?

Accordions are useful for compressing dense content into scannable sections. They preserve heading semantics and announce open/closed state to screen readers.

The body can hold arbitrary content — paragraphs, lists, even nested components.

  • Keyboard navigable
  • Animated
  • Themeable via CSS variables
 One more Short body.

Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current

Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

stories.name: Rich
stories.snippet:
const Rich = () => (
  <MenuV2 gutter={6}>
    <MenuV2.Trigger as={ButtonV2}>Open rich menu</MenuV2.Trigger>
    <MenuV2.Portal>
      <MenuV2.Content style={{ "min-width": "240px" }}>
        <MenuV2.Item shortcut="⇧ D" badge="Label">
          <Avatar size="small" kind="org" fallback="A" />
          <Icon name="settings" size="small" />
          Text
        </MenuV2.Item>
        <MenuV2.Item shortcut="⌘ N">
          <Icon name="plus" size="small" />
          New window
        </MenuV2.Item>
        <MenuV2.Item shortcut="⌘ S" badge="Beta">
          <Icon name="save" size="small" />
          Save as…
        </MenuV2.Item>
        <MenuV2.Separator />
        <MenuV2.Item disabled shortcut="⌘ P">
          <Icon name="print" size="small" />
          Print
        </MenuV2.Item>
      </MenuV2.Content>
    </MenuV2.Portal>
  </MenuV2>
);

stories.name: With Checkbox
With Radio
stories.snippet:
const WithRadio = () => {
  const [theme, setTheme] = createSignal("system")
  return (
    <MenuV2 gutter={6}>
      <MenuV2.Trigger as={ButtonV2}>Theme</MenuV2.Trigger>
      <MenuV2.Portal>
        <MenuV2.Content style={{ "min-width": "200px" }}>
          <MenuV2.Group>
            <MenuV2.GroupLabel>Appearance</MenuV2.GroupLabel>
            <MenuV2.RadioGroup value={theme()} onChange={setTheme}>
              <MenuV2.RadioItem value="light">Light</MenuV2.RadioItem>
              <MenuV2.RadioItem value="dark">Dark</MenuV2.RadioItem>
              <MenuV2.RadioItem value="system" badge="Auto">
                System
              </MenuV2.RadioItem>
            </MenuV2.RadioGroup>
          </MenuV2.Group>
        </MenuV2.Content>
      </MenuV2.Portal>
    </MenuV2>
  )
};

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

name.name: name
name.description:
The name of the select.
Submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

validationState.name: validationState
validationState.description: Whether the select should display its "valid" or "invalid" visual styling.

required.name: required
required.description: Whether the user must select an item before the owning form can be submitted.

readOnly.name: readOnly
readOnly.description: Whether the select is read only.

open.name: open
open.description: The controlled open state of the select.

defaultOpen.name: defaultOpen
defaultOpen.description:
The default open state when initially rendered.
Useful when you do not need to control the open state.

getAnchorRect.name: getAnchorRect
getAnchorRect.description:
Function that returns the anchor element's DOMRect. If this is explicitly
passed, it will override the anchor `getBoundingClientRect` method.

gutter.name: gutter
gutter.description:
The distance between the popper and the anchor element.
By default, it's 0 plus half of the arrow offset, if it exists.

flip.name: flip
flip.description:
Controls the behavior of the popper when it overflows the viewport:
  - If a `boolean`, specifies whether the popper should flip to the
    opposite side when it overflows.
  - If a `string`, indicates the preferred fallback placements when it
    overflows. The placements must be spaced-delimited, e.g. "top left".

slide.name: slide
slide.description: Whether the popper should slide when it overflows.

overlap.name: overlap
overlap.description: Whether the popper can overlap the anchor element when it overflows.

sameWidth.name: sameWidth
sameWidth.description:
Whether the popper should have the same width as the anchor element.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-anchor-width`.

fitViewport.name: fitViewport
fitViewport.description:
Whether the popper should fit the viewport. If this is set to true, the
popper positioner will have `maxWidth` and `maxHeight` set to the viewport size.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-content-available-width` and `--kb-popper-content-available-height`.

hideWhenDetached.name: hideWhenDetached
hideWhenDetached.description: Whether to hide the popper when the anchor element becomes occluded.

detachedPadding.name: detachedPadding
detachedPadding.description: The minimum padding in order to consider the anchor element occluded.

arrowPadding.name: arrowPadding
arrowPadding.description: The minimum padding between the arrow and the popper corner.

overflowPadding.name: overflowPadding
overflowPadding.description:
The minimum padding between the popper and the viewport edge.
This will be exposed to CSS as `--kb-popper-content-overflow-padding`.

modal.name: modal
modal.description:
Whether the select should be the only visible content for screen readers.
When set to `true`:
- interaction with outside elements will be disabled.
- scroll will be locked.
- focus will be locked inside the select content.
- elements outside the select content will not be visible for screen readers.

preventScroll.name: preventScroll
preventScroll.description: Whether the scroll should be locked even if the select is not modal.

forceMount.name: forceMount
forceMount.description:
Used to force mounting the select (portal, positioner and content) when more control is needed.
Useful when controlling animation with SolidJS animation libraries.

onOpenChange.name: onOpenChange
onOpenChange.description: Event handler called when the open state of the select changes.

placeholder.name: placeholder
placeholder.description: The content that will be rendered when no value or defaultValue is set.

optionValue.name: optionValue
optionValue.description:
Property name or getter function to use as the value of an option.
This is the value that will be submitted when the select is part of a `<form>`.

optionTextValue.name: optionTextValue
optionTextValue.description: Property name or getter function to use as the text value of an option for typeahead purpose.

optionDisabled.name: optionDisabled
optionDisabled.description: Property name or getter function to use as the disabled flag of an option.

optionGroupChildren.name: optionGroupChildren
optionGroupChildren.description: Property name that refers to the children options of an option group.

keyboardDelegate.name: keyboardDelegate
keyboardDelegate.description: An optional keyboard delegate implementation for type to select, to override the default.

selectionBehavior.name: selectionBehavior
selectionBehavior.description: How multiple selection should behave in the select.

allowDuplicateSelectionEvents.name: allowDuplicateSelectionEvents
allowDuplicateSelectionEvents.description: Whether onValueChange should fire even if the new set of keys is the same as the last.

disallowEmptySelection.name: disallowEmptySelection
disallowEmptySelection.description: Whether the select allows empty selection.

closeOnSelection.name: closeOnSelection
closeOnSelection.description: Whether the select closes after selection.

virtualized.name: virtualized
virtualized.description: Whether the select uses virtual scrolling.

appearance.name: appearance
appearance.description: `base` / `large` match text-input-v2; `inline` is a compact settings-row trigger.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.

aria-controls.name: aria-controls
aria-controls.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) whose contents or presence are controlled by the current
element.

aria-current.name: aria-current
aria-current.description:
Indicates the element that represents the current item within a container or set of related
elements.

aria-describedby.name: aria-describedby
aria-describedby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.

aria-disabled.name: aria-disabled
aria-disabled.description:
Indicates that the element is perceivable but disabled, so it is not editable or otherwise
operable.

aria-expanded.name: aria-expanded
aria-expanded.description:
Indicates whether the element, or another grouping element it controls, is currently expanded
or collapsed.

aria-hidden.name: aria-hidden
aria-hidden.description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to an accessibility API.

aria-label.name: aria-label
aria-label.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

aria-labelledby.name: aria-labelledby
aria-labelledby.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.

aria-live.name: aria-live
aria-live.description:
Indicates that an element will be updated, and describes the types of updates the user
agents, assistive technologies, and user can expect from the live region.
